title: Veeram Velancha Mannu
desc: Durai Pandi, a lumberjack, is very fond of his sister Meenamma and aims to make her the district collector. However, the MLA tricks him into cutting sandalwood trees and smuggling illegal goods.

title: Eeramana Rojave
desc: Shanthi and Siva fall in love in college. However, chaos ensues when a fellow student attempts to break their relationship.

title: Gopura Vasalile
desc: After losing his lover, teacher Manohar's life stagnates. His friends intervene, reigniting his passion for life and opening doors to new love.

title: Vada Poda Nanbargal
desc: Two men, who meet each other online but never in person, become good friends due to a series of events which makes one of them indebted to the other. However, a crack starts to seep in.

title: Unnai Thedi
desc: Raghu travels to New Zealand with a friend and meets Malavika, whom he falls in love with. However, circumstances force them to part ways.
